Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.

raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.8.2"
    node_exporter_user: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_group: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_binary_dir: "/usr/local/bin"
    node_exporter_listen_address: "0.0.0.0:9100"
    node_exporter_arch_map:
      x86_64: "amd64"
      aarch64: "arm64"
      armv7l: "armv7"
    node_exporter_arch: "{{ node_exporter_arch_map[ansible_architecture] | default('amd64') }}"
    node_exporter_archive: "node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
    node_exporter_download_url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
    node_exporter_checksums:
      "1.8.2-amd64": "6809dd0b3ec45fd6e992c19071d6b5253aed3ead7bf0686885a51d85c6643c66"
      "1.8.2-arm64": "627382b9723c642411c33f30c68ac86e7c41ff1ee8d9469a90291cb88aadefdc"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages are installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - tar
          - gzip
        state: present

  tasks:
    - name: Create node_exporter group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true
        state: present

    - name: Create node_exporter user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: /
        create_home: false
        state: present

    - name: Check if node_exporter binary exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_binary_dir }}/node_exporter"
      register: node_exporter_binary

    - name: Get installed node_exporter version
      ansible.builtin.command: "{{ node_exporter_binary_dir }}/node_exporter --version"
      register: node_exporter_installed_version
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      when: node_exporter_binary.stat.exists

    - name: Set installation required flag
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        node_exporter_install_required: >-
          {{ not node_exporter_binary.stat.exists or
             node_exporter_version not in (node_exporter_installed_version.stdout | default('')) }}

    - name: Download node_exporter archive
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_download_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
        checksum: "sha256:{{ node_exporter_checksums[node_exporter_version + '-' + node_exporter_arch] }}"
        mode: "0644"
        force: true
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Create temporary extraction directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Extract node_exporter archive
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
        dest: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}"
        remote_src: true
        extra_opts:
          - --strip-components=1
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Install node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_binary_dir }}/node_exporter"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true
      when: node_exporter_install_required
      notify: Restart node_exporter

    - name: Cleanup temporary files
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: absent
      loop:
        - "/tmp/{{ node_exporter_archive }}"
        - "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}"
      when: node_exporter_install_required

    - name: Deploy node_exporter systemd unit
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
          Documentation=https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ node_exporter_user }}
          Group={{ node_exporter_group }}
          ExecStart={{ node_exporter_binary_dir }}/node_exporter \
            --web.listen-address={{ node_exporter_listen_address }}
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5
          SyslogIdentifier=node_exporter

          # Security hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelLogs=true
          ProtectClock=true
          ProtectHostname=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          RestrictSUIDSGID=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictNamespaces=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWrite
